description: Targeted donor-catalog extensions. The base DONOR_ASSET_CATALOG.json is not rewritten; each extension adds catalog-schema assets plus a curation ledger (recovered-curation schema). Coverage invariant: base catalog + extension catalogs == base curation ledgers + extension curation ledgers, one record per asset.

extensions.scope: HGSS trainer battle sprites: files/a/0/5/8 (front) and files/a/0/0/6 (back)
HGSS human overworld sprite sheets: files/data/mmodel/mmodel/*.NSBTX (NPC/player scope rule in inventory_hgss_field_sprites.py)
HGSS field/building models (files/fielddata/build_model bm_field+bm_room), map texture sets (files/a/0/4/4) and follower sheets (MMODEL_FOLLOWER_MON* in files/data/mmodel/mmodel)
